query: Rewrite the Discussion of our sepsis-alert paper so it sounds like a clinical AI journal article: calibrated verbs, 'we' for interpretation, no hype, limitations in their own subsection. Draft is in manuscript/discussion.md.

Scan the whole manuscript for generic AI-writing tells like 'delve', 'tapestry', 'it is important to note' and remove them.
Run the final pre-submission gate on the manuscript: section discipline, voice, and anti-slop together before I send it to co-authors.

Review docs/plans/sap-v2.md for clarity and completeness before circulating it.
